de.abas.eks.jfop.annotation

Annotation Type Context


  • @Documented
 @Target(value={PARAMETER,FIELD})
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface Context
    This annotation is used to mark to which variables the JFOP-context is assigned.
    It can be used for method parameters of methodes marked with @RunFop and/or instance fields in a class can be run as a JFOP. The following types can be marked:
    • de.abas.erp.db.DbContext
    • de.abas.eks.jfop.remote.FOPSessionContext
    Author:
    male
